questions.question: What advantage does an abstract class have over an interface?
options: It can have constructors and implemented code
explanations: Java does not allow multiple inheritance.
Correct. Abstract classes can have constructors and methods with a body.
There is no difference in speed.

questions.question: What is a default method in an interface?
options: A method with a body that is not mandatory to override
explanations: Correct. default void doSomething() { ... } has a body; Override is not mandatory.

questions.question: What happens if a class implements two interfaces with the same default method?
options: The class must override the method to resolve the ambiguity
explanations: It is not always an error.
Correct. The class must Override to choose which one to use.

questions.question: Can an interface extend another interface?
explanations: Correct. interface B extends A { } is valid.
It can extend from multiple ones.
It is not multiple class inheritance.

questions.question: Which pattern uses an interface with a single abstract method?
What is the key difference between abstract class and interface?
options: Abstract class: single inheritance + shared code. Interface: contract + multiple implementation
explanations: Correct. Single inheritance vs multiple implementation is the fundamental difference.
